title: Customers
description: Individuals and business customers — balances, rentals, invoices and GDPR tools

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search name, email or Business ID…

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.hint: Add your first customer to track their rentals, invoices and open balance.
empty.filteredHint: Try another search term, type or archive filter.

detail.title: Customer details
detail.outstandingHint: Income entries still waiting for payment (invoiced or pending).

tabs.noRentals: No rentals for this customer yet.
tabs.noInvoices: No invoices for this customer yet.
tabs.noEntries: No income entries for this customer yet.

form.name: Name
form.businessIdInvalid: The check digit does not match — please double-check. It can still be saved.
form.businessIdSavedInvalid: Saved, but the Business ID check digit does not match. Please verify it.
form.phoneHint: Personal data — only admins can see the number.
form.phoneStaffHint: Personal data — once saved, only admins can see the number.
form.phoneHiddenHint: A stored number is hidden from you. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
form.badCountry: Use a 2-letter country code, e.g. FI

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.message: The customer is hidden from the active list. All rentals, invoices and entries stay unchanged, and you can restore the customer at any time.

gdpr.eraseMessage: This anonymises the customer under the GDPR right to erasure.
gdpr.eraseRemoves: Name, Business ID, email, phone, address and notes are removed. The customer becomes "Erased customer #id" and is archived.
gdpr.eraseKeeps: Financial rows (rentals, invoices, entries, payments) are kept for 6 years, as required by the Finnish Bookkeeping Act.
gdpr.eraseIrreversible: This cannot be undone. Export the data first if the customer asked for a copy.
gdpr.hasOutstanding: Cannot erase: the customer still has an outstanding balance or open invoices.
gdpr.hasOutstandingDetail: Cannot erase yet: {{amount}} is still outstanding ({{entries}} open entries, {{invoices}} unsettled invoices). Settle, void or cancel them first.

balance.nothingOwed: Nothing is owed — everything is paid.
balance.amountHint: Can be less than what is owed; the rest stays open.
balance.amountTooHigh: The payment cannot be more than the {{owed}} still owed
